title: Traffic-aware metric-fusion rollback advisor with synthetic baselining
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Current canary/autodeploy flow uses static thresholds for latency and error-rate which either cause noisy rollbacks during traffic spikes or allow regressions during low-sample windows. We need an advisor that fuses multiple signals (latency, error rate, throughput, token cost per request) and adapts thresholds based on traffic-sensitive baselines and synthetic probing so rollback decisions are stable and actionable.

Goal: Build a traffic-aware metric-fusion rollback advisor that: (1) creates baseline distributions per-cohort using synthetic probes and historical data, (2) computes a fused risk score across metrics with configurable weights, (3) applies sample-size aware stats (minimum N, Bayesian posterior or sequential testing) and hysteresis before triggering actions, and (4) supports graduated rollback actions (throttle, cohort-evict, full revert, route to fallback) and shadow/A-B testing instrumentation.

Scope: Advisor service + runtime hooks in rollout controller. Not in scope: UI polish for Console (will add follow-up PM/Design ticket), model quantization guidance, KMS changes.

Key constraints and principles: prioritize reliability over sensitivity; require minimum evidence windows; make thresholds explainable to SRE/PM via a per-trigger rationale payload; avoid single-metric veto unless configured for high-severity signals (e.g., silent 5xx spike).
acceptance_criteria: Advisor computes per-cohort baselines using last 7 days + synthetic probes and exposes baseline percentiles (P50,P90,P99)
Fused risk score implemented using weighted z-score aggregation with configurable weights via rollout policy
Triggering respects minimum sample size (configurable, default 100 requests) and reports confidence (Bayesian posterior or p-value adjusted sequential test)
Rollback actions implement three tiers: partial traffic withdraw (reduce canary to 0 in X steps), immediate full revert, and route-to-fallback model; each action emits audit event with rationale
Shadow and A/B experiment mode supported (no user-visible rollback in shadow; advisor only provides signals) and metrics are visible in Grafana
End-to-end integration tests covering: gradual canary ramp, transient spike (should not rollback), sustained degradation (should rollback), sample-starved cohort (no action)
design_notes: Metric fusion: compute per-metric standardized score = (observed - baseline.mean)/baseline.std with robust estimators; combine using weighted sum -> normalized risk in [0,1].

Baseline strategy: hybrid of historical rolling window (7d) and periodic synthetic probes that emulate representative prompt distribution. Synthetic probes carried on a pinned lightweight model in dedicated pool to isolate runtime variance.

Statistical test: default to Bayesian posterior comparison of error rates and Student-t / bootstrap on latency percentiles; sequential stopping rules (alpha spending) to avoid repeated false positives during ramp.
Hysteresis and cooldown: require two consecutive windows (default 5m windows) above threshold OR sustained deviation > 3x median absolute deviation over 15m; post-action cooldown default 30m.

Traffic-awareness: normalize thresholds by throughput band (low/med/high). Low-throughput cohorts use more conservative thresholds and longer windows. High-throughput cohorts allow tighter bounds and faster actuation.

Cost signal: token-cost trigger computed as rolling average tokens-per-request * model_cost_rate. If cost delta > configured percent and fused risk > low threshold, emit advisory to consider quantized variant or route to cheaper model.
Explainability: trigger payload includes top contributing metrics, baseline anchors, sample sizes, and suggested mitigation steps.
implementation_plan: Week 1: Prototype baseline collector + synthetic probe harness; define probe prompt set (from prod prompt sketchbook) and deploy to test pool
Week 2: Implement metric fusion library and risk scoring function; unit tests for edge cases (zero variance, small N)
Week 3: Integrate advisor into rollout controller as a pluggable policy; implement action primitives (reduce traffic, full revert, route-to-fallback)
Week 4: Add sequential/Bayesian tests, sample-size checks, hysteresis, and cooldowns; create grafana dashboards and alerting (dev cluster)
Week 5: Run canary experiments on staging with A/B and shadow modes; collect false-positive/negative stats; tune default weights and windows
Week 6: Hardening, security review (if flagged), and PR to main; prepare rollout playbook and runbook for on-call
updates: 2026-02-17: Kickoff meeting with PM and SRE. Agreed hybrid baseline (7d historical + synthetic probes). Added initial probe prompt set (10 prompts) from prompt-sketchbook.
2026-02-22: Prototype synthetic probe runner merged to test cluster (PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/3421). Probe job isolates pinned model to avoid eviction noise.
2026-03-02: Metric fusion library MVP implemented and bench-tested locally. Edge-case handling for near-zero variance added. Code review requested (PR: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4152).
2026-03-08: Integration spike with rollout controller completed; created canary policy schema extension 'advisor_policy' with weight config. Deployed to staging canary-tenant.

2026-03-10: First synthetic-drive A/B run in staging; observed conservative behavior during transient throughput spike (no rollback) — aligns with design. Planning tuning session with PM on 2026-03-12.
comments: PM @Rocio Martinez: please ensure the advisor provides an editable explanation for SREs. We need one-click 'force-revert' in Console on top of advisor actions.
Design @Hiro Tanaka: propose a compact payload for Console that highlights top-2 contributing metrics and a short remediation hint.
SRE @Nadia Khan: request integration with PagerDuty only for high-confidence full reverts; lower-tier advisories should create a ticket but not page.
Engineering review @Diego Alvarez: noted potential false-positive risk from cold-start latency; recommended excluding first N-instances from baseline and treating cold-start separately.
